title: The shifted coefficient factors of scalar forgetting commute with pullback
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring in $\operatorname{Type}(u+1)$, $W$ a scheme in universe $u$, $G$ an etale $\Lambda$-module sheaf on $W$, $q\in\mathbf Z$, $A,B\in\operatorname{Over}(W)$ and $f:A\to B$. Let $M=D^+f^*_{\Lambda}$, $H=D^+f^*_{\mathbf{Ab}}$, $V_A=D^+V_{A.left}$, $V_B=D^+V_{B.left}$ and $\epsilon:M\gg V_A\cong V_B\gg H$ be the real derived scalar comparison of [lem-sbc-raw-scalar-source-square]. Put $F_i=i.hom^*_{\Lambda}G$. Let $b_i$ be the shift comparison for $V_i$ on $F_i[0]$, followed by the shifted composite of its single comparison and singleFunctor of the inverse scalar coefficient comparison. Let $m_T$ be the shift comparison for $M$ on $F_B[0]$, followed by the shifted composite of the module inverse-image single comparison and singleFunctor of upperStarComp inverse for $(f.left,B.hom,A.hom)$ at $G$. Let $a_T$ be the corresponding abelian tail on $V_WG$ [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. Then $\epsilon^{-1}_{F_B[0][q]}\gg V_A(m_T)\gg b_A=H(b_B)\gg a_T$. This involves no base scheme, represented free source sheaf, or cohomology class.

proof.text: Specialize rawModuleScalar_source_square to S=W, Y=B.left, Y'=A.left, a=f.left, h=B.hom, h'=A.hom, w=Over.w f, L=G, E=V_W G, and t=id. All source factors are invertible. Apply IsIso.inv_eq_inv to the source-square equality and precompose both inverse composites by derivedPullbackIso.inv. Functor.map_inv, the inverse composition law, and cancellation of the derived comparison give coefficient_unshifted: epsilon.inv followed by V_A of the module coefficient tail and the scalar coefficient tail equals H of the scalar coefficient tail followed by the abelian coefficient tail.

Prove privately that the bounded-below derived natural-isomorphism and composition comparisons commute with shifts. Whisker each comparison by the faithful inclusion D+ into D; the inclusion formulas identify it with a composite of shift-compatible restriction comparisons and the already proved unbounded derived comparisons. Apply NatTrans.CommShift.of_whiskerRight. The inverse derivedPullbackIso, being their composite, commutes with shifts. The private generic shift_square transports the unshifted coefficient square using NatTrans.shift_app_comm, naturality of each functor's commShiftIso, and functoriality of the shift functor. Instantiate it with the four exact derived functors and the four unshifted tails; unfolding the existing coefficient-factor definitions gives the required equation for every integer q. No restriction on shifts, coefficient sheaves, or scheme arrows is introduced.

lean.statement:
theorem rawModuleScalar_coefficient_square
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W : Scheme.{u}}
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℤ)
    (A B : Over W) (f : A ⟶ B) :
  let VA := (RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ A.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlus
  let H := (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlus
  let FB := (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) B.hom).obj G
  let bA := scalarCoefficientFactor Λ A.hom G q
  let bB := scalarCoefficientFactor Λ B.hom G q
  let mT := moduleCoefficientFactor Λ G q A B f
  let aT := abelianCoefficientFactor ((RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ W).obj G) q A B f
  (RawModuleScalarComparison.derivedPullbackIso Λ f.left).inv.app
      (((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj FB)⟦q⟧) ≫
    VA.map mT ≫ bA = H.map bB ≫ aT
